gamerule.spacehorizons.vacuum_damage.des: Players suffocate in a vacuum (airless planets and above the atmosphere) when their oxygen runs out
death.attack.spacehorizons_vacuum: %1$s suffocated in the vacuum of space
death.attack.spacehorizons_vacuum.player: %1$s suffocated in the vacuum of space whilst trying to escape %2$s
jei.spacehorizons.info.fuel_canister: Craft it from 3 steel plates and 1 steel nugget. Put it in the refinery's canister slot: it fills with rocket fuel (up to 1000 mB) to carry it around.
jei.spacehorizons.info.forge_hammer: Craft it from 4 steel ingots and 2 sticks. Use it as an ingredient (for example, to make steel plates): it is not consumed, but loses 1 durability per craft.
